messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Severity=2 p99 latency spike on /v1/chat/completions (route: chat.default, model: mistral-compact-q). p95=620ms p99=1680ms. Count=1200 reqs/min.

Tess-oncall: I'm on it, paged. seeing the same in the dashboard.

Tess-oncall: quick check: is this a single-region blip or global?

Sam-eng-sre: looks like increased queue times on worker pool in us-west-2. CPU high on several nodes, KV-cache hit-rate normal.

Mike-platform: autoscaler shows backfill delayed due to GPU provisioning cooldown. I've kicked a manual scale to +8 instances.

Carol-ml: we recently rolled a new kernel patch for mistral-compact-q yesterday. Could be related. Any rollback telemetry?

Tess-oncall: @carol-ml good catch — no rollback available for runtime kernel. Can we reroute affected traffic to fallback model (mistral-compact-1.0) for now?

Carol-ml: yes, reroute policy exists. Recommend switching chat.default -> mistral-compact-1.0 (compatible) for latency sensitive customers. Doing a canary reroute to 10% first.

Tess-oncall: applying 10% canary now.

incident-bot: action=reroute canary=10% route=chat.default -> model=mistral-compact-1.0 triggered by Tess-oncall

Natalie-support: customer-facing: small number of conversational customers reported slow responses ~1.5s. Not yet inflight escalations. I'll prepare a status blurb in case we need one.

Sam-eng-sre: after canary, p99 dropped to ~900ms for canary traffic. Overall p99 dropping slowly; still high for total.

Mike-platform: manual scale added 8 nodes, but provisioning is still coming up. ETA ~70s.

Tess-oncall: given noise, I'm going to mute the per-route p95 alert for chat.default for 10m to avoid paging on noisy partial degradation. We'll keep p99 live.

Carol-ml: agree. p95 is noisy during gradual roll events. We should add a per-model p99 override and keep p95 with longer debounce.

Sam-eng-sre: muting p95 for chat.default for 10m (reason: active mitigation, manual scale+routing). Leaving p99.

incident-bot: alert_mute: channel=eng-oncall rule=chat.default.p95 duration=10m by Tess-oncall

Tess-oncall: p99 now trending ~720ms after canary + scale. Marking mitigated for paging but not closed.

Mike-platform: nodes healthy; autoscaler cooldown adjusted to avoid throttling on burst. I'll open a follow-up to tune cooldown and warm-pool size.

Carol-ml: follow-ups: (1) revert kernel patch if we confirm regression, (2) add per-model p99 thresholds because mistral-compact-q has different baseline, (3) create dashboard tile showing model-level p95/p99 by route.

Tess-oncall: creating tickets: infra-#4321 (autoscaler cooldown), ml-#5678 (kernel regression triage + rollback), obs-#7890 (dashboard + alert config: per-model p95 debounce + per-model p99 thresholds). Assigning owners.

Natalie-support: I'll add a note to the customer status draft: "Experiencing elevated latency for chat completions; mitigation in progress. No data loss." Ask if you want me to post.

Tess-oncall: hold on posting until we confirm full recovery or need to notify customers. Thanks everyone.

Sam-eng-sre: retrospective action: lower noise by changing alert logic: require sustained p95 deviation (>3min) or elevated request queue depth. Also add automated fallback to compatible model after x% error/latency. I'll PR proposal to alerts repo.

Carol-ml: I'll run canary validation on kernel in staging with load profile sim matching chat.default. We should block future rollouts until that passes.

Tess-oncall: final status: paging mitigated (no further pages). Leaving p99 watch for 20min, then will mark incident resolved and add notes to oncall log.

incident-bot: incident_note: mitigated_by=routing+scale pending_resolution_in=20m added_by=Tess-oncall

Tess-oncall: thanks team. Post-incident items: please pick up tickets infra-#4321, ml-#5678, obs-#7890 and update runbook to include per-model p99 thresholds and a runbook step for immediate reroute.

Natalie-support: noted, will update customer comms template once we have final incident writeup.
